Source: https://rivian.com/autonomy ; https://stories.rivian.com/enhanced-highway-assist-gen2
adasOptional: Max-pack option ($7,000) raises EPA range to 420 mi but is not an ADAS upsell. Performance Upgrade ($5,000) increases output to 665 hp / 829 lb-ft / 3.4 s 0-60 — not ADAS-related. rearViewCameraNotes: Standard high-resolution rear-view camera with dynamic guidelines, integrated into the 16-inch center display and Surround Vision. Source: https://rivian.com/r1t
sideViewCameraNotes: Standard 360-degree Surround Vision; turn-signal-triggered side camera feeds; OTA-enabled camera-based trailer assist. Source: https://rivian.com/r1t
subscriptionFeatures: Connect+ ($14.99/mo or $149.99/yr): in-vehicle Wi-Fi hotspot, satellite map imagery, Alexa connected commands, streaming app data, Gear Guard Live Cam, Google Cast, YouTube. Core driving and Connect features unaffected by lapse. Source: https://rivian.com/connect-plus
drmNotes: Drives without connectivity, but navigation, OTA, and lane-keeping assist degrade if connectivity is disabled per Rivian's own support docs. Source: https://rivian.com/support/article/can-i-disable-all-data-collection-from-my-vehicle

recalls: Same MY2025 recall set as Dual Standard: HVDB grounding, ADAS Highway Assist pre-2025.18.30, second-row seat-belt retractor bolt, front turn signals, cold-weather low-beam headlight, rear suspension toe-link joint (post-service pre-March 2025). Source: https://rivian.com/support/article/recall-information
stateIncentives: Federal Clean Vehicle Credit not available 2025; varied state programs (CA CVRP, CO, NY Drive Clean, MA MOR-EV, NJ BEV sales-tax exemption, OR Clean Vehicle Rebate). Verify per state. Source: https://rivian.com/support/incentives

title: Dual Standard
infotainment: 16-inch center touchscreen (Rivian-developed in-house OS) + 12.3-inch digital instrument cluster. Over-the-air updates monthly.
adasStandard: Rivian Autonomy Platform standard on all Gen-2 R1T: adaptive cruise control, Highway Assist (Level 2 hands-on lane-centering on 135k+ miles of US/Canada highway), automatic emergency braking, blind-spot monitoring, rear cross-traffic alert, lane-departure warning, lane-keeping assist, traffic-sign recognition, driver-monitoring camera, 360-degree camera with surround view. As of the March 2025 OTA, Enhanced Highway Assist adds hands-free lane-keeping on supported roads. Source: https://rivian.com/autonomy ; https://stories.rivian.com/enhanced-highway-assist-gen2
adasOptional: No additional ADAS hardware/software upsell — Gen-2 ships every R1T with the same Autonomy Platform; Rivian's roadmap (announced Jan 2025) is to add eyes-off Level-3-class supervised hands-free in 2026 via OTA to existing Gen-2 hardware. Source: https://electrek.co/2025/01/23/rivian-rivn-plans-hands-free-driving-this-year-eyes-free-2026/
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard high-resolution rear-view camera with dynamic guidelines integrated into the 16-inch center display; tied into Surround Vision. Source: https://rivian.com/r1t
sideViewCameraNotes: Standard 360-degree Surround Vision (front, rear, and side cameras stitched into a top-down view) plus side cameras viewable on the center screen when a turn signal is activated. No Honda-LaneWatch-style dedicated single-side feed. Camera-based trailer assist is available via OTA. Source: https://rivian.com/r1t
subscriptionFeatures: Connect+ subscription ($14.99/mo or $149.99/yr) gates: in-vehicle Wi-Fi hotspot, satellite map imagery, Alexa connected commands, streaming app data, Gear Guard Live Cam, Google Cast, YouTube. Lapse leaves core driving and Connect features intact. No subscription gates on heated seats, ADAS, performance, or range. Source: https://rivian.com/connect-plus ; https://rivian.com/legal/subscription
drmNotes: Vehicle drives without cellular connectivity, but many features degrade: navigation, OTA updates, lane-keeping assist (per Rivian's own data-disable support article), and any Connect+ media require connectivity. Disabling all connectivity is supported but is a significant feature regression. Source: https://rivian.com/support/article/can-i-disable-all-data-collection-from-my-vehicle
killSwitchNotes: No federal impaired-driving kill switch is present on MY2025 R1T (FMVSS rule not yet in force). The vehicle does include a driver-monitoring camera used to enforce hands-on/eyes-on policy for Highway Assist, which throttles the ADAS feature rather than disabling the vehicle. Source: https://rivian.com/autonomy
knownIssues: MY2025 known issues from owner forums and CR reports: phantom touchscreen issues, occasional false ADAS alerts at low speed, drive-unit calibration after software updates, frunk/tailgate sensor false positives, charge-port door icing in cold climates, headlight low-beam cold-weather failure (recall). Consumer Reports rated 2025 R1T 18/100 on reliability. Sources: https://recharged.com/articles/2025-rivian-r1t-reliability ; https://www.consumerreports.org/cars/rivian/r1t/2025/reliability/
recalls: MY2025 R1T affected by multiple Rivian recalls: (a) High Voltage Distribution Box (HVDB) improperly grounded — risk of sudden power loss; inspect/repair or replace HV battery free of charge; (b) Highway Assist software defect (build pre-2025.18.30) — fixed by OTA; (c) Second-row seat-belt retractor bolt may be improperly installed; (d) Front turn-signal lamps may not illuminate; (e) Cold-weather headlight low-beam failure; (f) Rear suspension toe-link joint separation (for vehicles previously serviced pre-March 2025). Sources: https://www.wardsauto.com/news/rivian-recalls-nearly-20000-r1t-r1s-evs-over-flawed-rear-suspension-service-procedure/809380/ ; https://rivian.com/support/article/recall-information
stateIncentives: Rivian lost federal Clean Vehicle Credit eligibility in 2025. State incentives vary: CA Clean Vehicle Rebate Program (income-capped), CO state EV tax credit, NY Drive Clean Rebate, MA MOR-EV, NJ sales-tax exemption on BEVs, OR Clean Vehicle Rebate, etc. — verify against the buyer's state at https://rivian.com/support/incentives. Sources: https://www.carsdirect.com/automotive-news/2025-rivian-evs-lose-ev-tax-credit ; https://rivian.com/support/incentives

title: Performance
infotainment: Center touchscreen (Rivian OS — smaller than R1 but with the same software stack) + digital cluster. Native YouTube, Google Cast, streaming apps. No CarPlay or Android Auto.
adasStandard: Rivian Autonomy Platform standard on R2: adaptive cruise, Enhanced Highway Assist (hands-free on supported roads), AEB, BSM, rear cross-traffic, lane-keep assist, traffic-sign recognition, driver-monitoring camera, 360-degree Surround Vision. Source: https://rivian.com/autonomy
adasOptional: Rivian's hands-free Enhanced Highway Assist is included; eyes-off supervised feature targeted for OTA rollout to existing Gen-2 + R2 hardware in late 2026. Source: https://www.rivianwave.com/news/2511/rivian-announces-hands-free-driving-coming-soon-eyes-off-in-2026
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard high-res rear camera with dynamic guidelines; Surround Vision on the center touchscreen. Source: https://rivian.com/r2
sideViewCameraNotes: Standard 360-degree Surround Vision; turn-signal-triggered side camera views. No dedicated Honda-LaneWatch-style side feed. Source: https://rivian.com/r2
subscriptionFeatures: Connect+ ($14.99/mo or $149.99/yr): in-vehicle Wi-Fi hotspot, satellite map imagery, Alexa connected commands, streaming app data, Gear Guard Live Cam, Google Cast, YouTube. No driving/ADAS/range/seat-heat gating. Source: https://rivian.com/connect-plus
drmNotes: R2 shares Rivian's Gen-2 connectivity model. Vehicle drives without cellular but several features (live navigation, lane-keeping assist, OTA updates, Connect+ media) degrade if all data is disabled per Rivian's support documentation. Source: https://rivian.com/support/article/can-i-disable-all-data-collection-from-my-vehicle
killSwitchNotes: No federal impaired-driving kill switch present on the 2026 R2 (FMVSS rule not yet in force as of 2026-05-21). The DMS camera enforces hands-on/eyes-on for Enhanced Highway Assist by limiting the ADAS feature, not the vehicle. Source: https://rivian.com/autonomy
knownIssues: Brand-new model. Early reviewer reports cite typical first-build software polish issues (touchscreen lag, OTA pacing) and trim-piece complaints. Data unavailable: no long-term reliability data exists yet for the R2. Source: https://www.consumerreports.org/cars/rivian/r2/2026/road-test-report/
recalls: No recalls announced for the R2 as of 2026-05-21. Source: https://rivian.com/support/article/recall-information
stateIncentives: Federal Clean Vehicle Credit expired Sept 30 2025 — R2 deliveries in Spring 2026 fall outside the credit window. Some commentators believe a sub-200k-vehicle exception could restore eligibility if enacted, but no current eligibility as of 2026-05. State programs still apply (CA CVRP, CO, NY, MA MOR-EV, NJ BEV sales-tax exemption, OR). Sources: https://electrek.co/2025/05/13/ev-tax-credit-going-away-rivian-evs-could-still-qualify-2026-r2/ ; https://rivian.com/support/incentives
